decision.reasoning_trace: I evaluated several types of packs including tactical, cooler, dry bag, hydration, and sling options. I ultimately chose the Seibertron Falcon Tactical Backpack (prod_backpacks_107) because of its high rating (4.6) and large number of reviews (2,959), which suggests reliability. It offers the best balance of capacity (37L) and versatility for hiking and travel compared to the more niche items like the cooler backpack (prod_backpacks_002) or the smaller sling bag (prod_backpacks_182).
